# CountLink

> Free shared countdown timer. Set a duration, copy the link, and everyone who opens it sees the identical countdown — synced by encoding the end timestamp in the URL itself, with no account and no server round-trip.

CountLink is a static web app: no signup, no backend, no per-viewer cost. The sync mechanic (timestamp embedded in the shared link) is the core differentiator versus real-time-server competitors like ShareMyTimer and Stagetimer.io — see the comparison page below for specifics.

## Primary pages

## Guides
- [How to put a timer on your classroom screen](https://countlink.app/guides/put-a-timer-on-your-classroom-screen): Getting a countdown onto the interactive whiteboard, a smart TV, a projector, a Chromebook or an iPad — what actually works on each, and what to do when the screen keeps sleeping.
- [Timeboxing: how to run meetings that actually end on time](https://countlink.app/guides/timeboxing-meetings): Meetings overrun because time is invisible. Timeboxing — giving each part of a meeting a fixed, visible limit — is the simple fix. Here's how to do it well.
- [How to run a fair timed exam or test](https://countlink.app/guides/how-to-run-a-timed-exam): Timing an exam sounds simple until you're doing it for a room. A practical guide to running a fair, unambiguous timed test — the clock, the announcements, the edge cases.
- [The Pomodoro Technique, explained — and how to do it as a group](https://countlink.app/guides/the-pomodoro-technique): The Pomodoro Technique in practice: why 25-minute focus blocks work, how to run them, common mistakes, and how to keep a whole study group or team in sync.
- [How to run a daily standup that stays short](https://countlink.app/guides/running-short-standups): Daily standups balloon into status meetings when nobody watches the clock. A practical guide to keeping them short, focused and actually useful.
- [Using timers in the classroom: a practical guide for teachers](https://countlink.app/guides/using-timers-in-the-classroom): A visible countdown is one of the simplest classroom-management tools there is. How to use timers well for transitions, group work, tests and focus — by age group.
- [Facilitating a workshop to time without herding people](https://countlink.app/guides/facilitating-workshops-to-time): Keeping a workshop on schedule is a facilitator's hardest job. How to plan realistic timings, run breakout groups that finish together, and stay on track.
- [Interval training timing explained: Tabata, HIIT and boxing rounds](https://countlink.app/guides/interval-training-timing): Work, rest, repeat — but the exact numbers define the workout. A guide to interval training timing, from Tabata to boxing rounds, and why a shared clock helps.

## Timers
### Durations
- [Timer Durations](https://countlink.app/timers/): Free shared timers from 1 minute to an hour, plus a shared stopwatch. Set a duration, copy the link, and every screen counts down to the same second — no account, no viewer limit.

### Classroom & exams
- [Exam Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/exam-timer): A shareable exam timer for classrooms and test centres. Every invigilator's screen and every student device shows the identical countdown to the second.
- [Classroom Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/classroom-timer): A free classroom timer built for transitions, group work and quiz rounds — project it or share the link so every student sees the same countdown.
- [Group Study Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/group-study-timer): A free shared study timer for study groups and study-with-me sessions. Set a focus block, share the link, and everyone's break lands at the same moment.

### Meetings
- [Webinar Countdown](https://countlink.app/timers/webinar-countdown): A shareable pre-webinar countdown. Put the link in your registration email or waiting room so every attendee's screen counts down to the same start time.
- [Standup Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/standup-timer): A free shareable standup timer for teams. Set the length once, drop the link in Slack, and everyone sees the same countdown to keep standup on time.
- [Zoom Meeting Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/zoom-meeting-timer): A free shared timer for Zoom calls that doesn't need screen-sharing — copy the link into the chat and everyone's own screen counts down together.
- [Google Meet Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/google-meet-timer): A free shared timer for Google Meet. Copy the link into the meeting chat and everyone's own screen counts down in sync — no extension, no screen share.
- [Workshop Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/workshop-timer): A free shared timer for workshop facilitators. Set the segment length, share the link, and every table or breakout group sees the identical countdown.

### Streaming
- [Stream Countdown (OBS)](https://countlink.app/timers/obs-countdown-timer): A free stream-starting countdown for OBS, Twitch and YouTube — a transparent browser-source overlay with no watermark, plus a link to share with mods and co-streamers.

### Focus & intervals
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/pomodoro-timer): A free 25-minute pomodoro timer you can share: the whole study group or team focuses to the same clock, then breaks together.
- [Interval Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/interval-timer): A free shareable interval timer — Tabata 20/10, boxing 3-minute rounds, or any custom work/rest split and round count, with every screen on the identical round.

### Multi-stage
- [Multiple Timers](https://countlink.app/timers/multiple-timers-at-once): Run several named countdowns on one screen — cooking, multi-station events, parallel exam sections — all synced by one shareable link.
- [Agenda Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/agenda-timer): Build an ordered agenda of named segments — intro, break, Q&A — and it auto-advances through them for everyone who opens the link, no server involved.

### Play & events
- [Game Night Timer](https://countlink.app/timers/game-night-timer): A free shareable timer for board games and game night house rules. Set the turn limit, share the link, and nobody argues about how much time is left.
- [Auction Countdown](https://countlink.app/timers/auction-countdown): A free countdown for live and online auctions. Share the link so every bidder sees the exact same time remaining before bidding closes.

### Seasonal
- [New Year Countdown](https://countlink.app/timers/new-year-countdown): A live countdown to New Year you can share: days, hours, minutes and seconds to midnight January 1st, identical on every screen that opens the link.
- [Christmas Countdown](https://countlink.app/timers/christmas-countdown): A live Christmas countdown you can share: days, hours, minutes and seconds until December 25th, the same on every screen that opens the link.
